checks.name: left_compact_strong_mutant
checks.statement: Strong convergence cannot justify compact-left multiplication without adjoints.
checks.evidence: X_n=e1 tensor en ->0 strongly, P1 X_n=X_n has norm one; X_n*e1=en does not converge to zero.

checks.name: nonselfadjoint_projection_mutant
checks.statement: Dropping background selfadjointness permits norm-projection failure.
checks.evidence: Embed this block on e1,en: projection error remains exactly 1/3, despite strong background convergence and fixed compact correction.

checks.name: strong_correction_pollution_mutant
checks.statement: Strong convergence of compact corrections cannot replace norm convergence.
checks.evidence: C_n=3P_en is compact and strongly tends to zero but has eigenvalue 3 and norm 3 at every n; the limiting zero operator has no spectral point at 3.

checks.name: ball_harmonic_gap
checks.statement: Shifted harmonic eigenvalues ell>=2 are at least 1/15.
checks.evidence: The inequality reduces to 15(ell-1)>=3(2ell+1), i.e. ell>=2; the 1/6 accumulation is retained.

checks.name: physical_embedding_weight
checks.statement: J_h is an isometry precisely with the common h^3 sequence weight.
checks.evidence: Cell integral norm and weighted vector norm agree; omission of h^3 is detected for h!=1.

scope: Finite exact identities and explicitly proved infinite-family controls. They do not certify lattice endpoint extrema, historical priority or replace operator proofs.
